Verse of the Day
For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
Isaiah 9:6
Quote of the Day
"When we have doubts, when discipleship feels demanding, when others turn back, that is the moment to stay bound to Christ."
Elder Brian J. Holmes | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
